name: astril: Quantify segmentation volumes
desc: Stage 3b - per-class segmentation volumes (mm3) from a set of segmentation masks. Runs automatically as part of Stage 3a (segment) by default; register/run this separately to re-quantify a manually corrected or replacement set of masks (optionally merging multiple segmentation sources first) without re-running segmentation. Versions: astril-nf 0.1.0, astril 0.7.30.
